content.text:
All 3 tests pass.

The bug in `src/config.js` was an unguarded `config.server.port`, which threw when `server` was absent and returned `undefined` when the port wasn't set. Fixed by using optional chaining plus a nullish default:

```js
return config.server?.port ?? 3000;
```

`??` (not `||`) is used so a legitimate port of `0` would still be returned rather than replaced by the default.

content.text:
Fixed `src/config.js`.

`getPort` assumed `config.server` always existed and always had a `port`, so it threw on `{}` and returned `undefined` on `{ server: {} }`. It now uses optional chaining plus a nullish default:

```js
return config?.server?.port ?? 3000;
```

All 3 tests pass; nothing under `test/` was touched.
